description: Converted to represent a Mitsubishi A6M Zero for film work, including Steven Spielberg's Empire of the Sun; carries Imperial Japanese Navy markings. Part of AeroRetro's flying collection, kept in the association's hangar on the Saint-Rambert-d'Albon aerodrome and shown to visitors on Wednesday afternoons and at weekends.
